entities.summary: Nagore Robles Gutiérrez is a Spanish television presenter and collaborator who rose to prominence after her participation in the reality show Gran Hermano in the season 11 in 2009. Since then, she has participated in various television programs, mainly developing her career within the Mediaset España group.
